node.statement: Define c0_prime:=max{1,c0}. Then c0_prime>=1 and, by the preceding sign derivation, 0<=c0<=c0_prime. For every 0<=epsilon<=epsilon_max^cb, 0<=c0*epsilon<=c0_prime*epsilon. Thus lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone upgrades every replacement extended (c0*epsilon)-inclusion supplied by lem-maincb-error-improvement to an extended (c0_prime*epsilon)-inclusion. The replacement map itself is unchanged, so its bijectivity whenever the input is bijective is unchanged. Renaming c0_prime as c0 proves that the error-improvement witness may be chosen with c0>=1.
